summary: Iteration 2 frontend E2E (post-fix) for AI Cost & Reliability Autopilot. Supabase Email provider is back on, retry wrapper for Supabase disconnects works, and Projects/Usage/ProjectDetail no longer crash to webpack overlay on transient errors. Ran the full flow list from iteration_1's not_tested_due_to_blocker — every item passed. No blockers remain. Only a few minor data-testid gaps and one UX nit around the Settings email field.

ui_bugs.issue: Full name <input> has NO data-testid="full-name-input" (only Save button has save-profile-btn). Automated tests / spec expect full-name-input. Field itself works (name saves and toast shows).

Email <input> is not marked readonly and its value is empty; the email is shown via placeholder text only. Spec says email should be read-only. It renders correctly to the eye but is technically an empty editable input.

Reliability KPI cards (success/error/timeouts/avg-latency/p50/p95/p99) and failures tables have NO data-testid attributes (only rel-trend exists on the error-trend chart). Page renders correctly with real values, but automated coverage is limited.
ui_bugs.selector: Reliability page KPI cards + failures-by-* tables

verified_working: Dashboard KPIs with Last 30 days: kpi-spend=$43.90 USD, kpi-requests=2,017, kpi-tokens=6.5M (4.7M in / 1.8M out), kpi-avg-cost=$0.0218, kpi-success=95.1% (4.9% errors), kpi-savings shows '—' placeholder
chart-spend and chart-requests both render with real time-series data
Sidebar nav to Projects, Usage, Costs, Reliability, Optimization, Settings all navigate correctly
Costs page: total spend/requests/avg cost, spend-over-time chart, and 4 breakdown cards (breakdown-provider/model/workflow/feature) with real values

Reliability page renders SUCCESS RATE 95.1%, ERROR RATE 4.9% (99 errors), TIMEOUTS 27, AVG LATENCY 1,359.8ms, P50 1,061ms, P95 2,487ms, P99 9,845.6ms, RATE-LIMIT ERRORS 38, error trend bar chart, and failures by provider/model/workflow/feature tables
Usage page paginated table; usage-next changes first-row content; usage-prev restores original row (verified diff)

Projects: Demo Production App listed with 2,016 events; New Project dialog (new-project-btn -> project-name-input -> project-env-select -> project-create-submit) creates the project and it appears in the list with a 'Project created' toast
Project Detail Overview tab shows scoped SPEND/REQUESTS/SUCCESS RATE/AVG LATENCY and Spend by model/workflow sections

API Keys tab -> create-key-btn opens dialog -> key-name-input -> key-create-submit shows reveal-once dialog with revealed-key (acp_live_...), copy-key-btn present, warning text 'Copy and store this key securely now. You won’t be able to see it again.' visible
After key-done-btn, table shows masked prefix only (e.g. acp_live_28c01••••••••); full key no longer present in DOM
revoke-key-<id> revokes the key and status changes to 'revoked' with 'Key revoked' toast
Optimization page shows exact placeholder text: 'Optimization intelligence is being prepared from your usage data.'
Settings: workspace card shows role 'owner'; Model pricing table lists 7 demo pricing rows (anthropic/google/openai/openrouter). Save profile button triggers success toast.
Seed Demo Data (seed-demo-data-btn) triggers a success toast (idempotent path)
Logout via user-menu-btn -> menu-logout returns to /login; navigating to /dashboard while logged out redirects to /login
critical_code_review_comments: Add data-testid attributes on Reliability page KPI cards (kpi-success, kpi-error, kpi-timeouts, kpi-avg-latency, kpi-p50, kpi-p95, kpi-p99) and failures tables (failures-provider/model/workflow) for consistent automation.
Settings.js: mark the email input readOnly and set its value to the current user email; today it uses placeholder-only which is easy to mistake for a filled field.
Settings.js: add data-testid='full-name-input' on the Full name input so profile-save flow is fully testable via testids.
action_items: Add missing data-testids on Reliability page KPI cards and failures tables.
Add data-testid='full-name-input' and mark Settings email input readOnly with the user's email as value (not placeholder).
No blocking backend or auth issues — main agent can proceed.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only run; observed no 5xx during full flow)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 test project via UI (TEST_Proj_<ts>) and 1 test API key on Demo Production App (revoked at end).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything from the phase-1 scenario list is now working end-to-end. Reliability testids are absent; if a future spec asks for them, verify data-testids are added. Settings email is placeholder-only, not readonly — minor UX. A stray TEST_Proj_* project may exist in founder's workspace and one revoked TEST_key_* under Demo Production App.
